instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
red_pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]
green_case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

# Find grasp candidate for red_pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
# Choose the first candidate (or any valid one)
candidate = candidates[0]

# Grasp the red_pen
grasp_result = grasp(candidate)

# Check if grasped successfully
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

# Find free spot in green_case
spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")["spots"]
if not spots:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

# Choose the first free spot
spot = spots[0]

# Carry to spot with correct orientation
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])

# Rotate if needed to align with zone's long axis
delta = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - obs["gripper"]["yaw"]
if abs(delta) > 0.1:
    rotate_by(delta)

# Lower until contact with green_case
lower_until_contact()

# Release the pen
open_gripper()

# Retreat
retreat()

# Check success
check_result = check("red_pen", "green_case")
if not check_result["satisfied"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Red_pen not properly placed in green_case")
